subject: Workplace Skills
title: The Currency of Favors
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Currency of Favors.

hook.text: A researcher helped a colleague with a grant application. Two years later that colleague funded her lab.

buildup.text: Workplace relationships run on reciprocity. Favors given create debt. Favors received create obligation.

discovery.text: Building a bank of goodwill means helping others before you need anything. The withdrawal comes later.

twist.text: Keeping score explicitly feels transactional. Genuine help without strings builds the strongest bonds.

climax.text: Be generous with your expertise and time. People remember who helped when nobody was watching.

punchline.text: Help without keeping score. The returns compound.

quiz.question: How does the currency of favors work in organizations?
options: Track favors in a spreadsheet and call them in strategically
Help others genuinely and goodwill compounds over time
Only help people who can promote you
